        t."amount" AS transaction_amount,
        t."k_symbol" AS transaction_k_symbol
    FROM
        "trans" t
    JOIN
        client_accounts ca ON t."account_id" = ca."account_id"
    WHERE
        t."date" >= (SELECT MAX("date") FROM "trans") - INTERVAL '3 months'
        AND t."type" IN ('VYDAJ', 'PRIJEM')

SELECT
    
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cl."loan_status" IN ('A', 'B', 'C', 'D') THEN cl."loan_amount" ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_debt_amount,

    
    STRING_AGG(
        DISTINCT cl."loan_status",
        ', ' ORDER BY cl."loan_status"
    ) AS loan_statuses,

    
    COALESCE(AVG(cl."monthly_payment"), 0) AS avg_monthly_payment,

    
    COUNT(DISTINCT ct."trans_id") AS recent_payment_transactions_count,

    
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ct."transaction_k_symbol" IN ('UVER', 'SIPO') THEN ct."transaction_amount" ELSE 0 END), 0) AS recent_payment_amount,

    
    COALESCE(
        AVG(CASE WHEN ct."transaction_k_symbol" IN ('UVER', 'SIPO') THEN ct."transaction_amount" ELSE NULL END),
        0
    ) AS avg_actual_payment,

    
    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(cl."loan_id") = 0 THEN 'No active loans'
        WHEN COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ct."transaction_k_symbol" IN ('UVER', 'SIPO') THEN ct."transaction_amount" ELSE 0 END), 0) >=
             COALESCE(SUM(cl."monthly_payment"), 0) THEN 'Payments on track'
        ELSE 'Payments behind schedule'
    END AS payment_status

    client_loans cl

    client_transactions ct ON cl."account_id" = ct."account_id"

    cl."client_id";

WITH yearly_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c."segment",
        SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4)::INTEGER AS year,
        SUM(ym."consumption") AS total_consumption
    FROM
        "yearmonth" ym
    JOIN
        "customers" c ON ym."customerid" = c."customerid"
    WHERE
        c."currency" = 'EUR'
        AND SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4) IN (2012, 2013)
    GROUP BY
        c."segment", SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4)
),
segment_changes AS (
    SELECT
        "segment",
        MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2012 THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2013 THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013,
        (MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2013 THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) -
         MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2012 THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END)) AS absolute_change,
        CASE
            WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2013 THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2013 THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) -
                  MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2012 THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
                  MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2013 THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END)
        END AS percentage_change
    FROM
        yearly_consumption
    GROUP BY
        "segment"
)
SELECT
    "segment",
    consumption_2012,
    consumption_2013,
    absolute_change,
    percentage_change,
    CASE
        WHEN percentage_change = (SELECT MAX(percentage_change) FROM segment_changes)
        THEN 'Biggest increase'
        WHEN percentage_change = (SELECT MIN(percentage_change) FROM segment_changes)
        THEN 'Lowest increase'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS change_type
FROM
    segment_changes
ORDER BY
    percentage_change DESC;
